description: Part of op-72hy. Today Access::is_committable() (crates/kovan/src/entity.rs) is the ONLY switch: Open=committable, Restricted=gitignored-forever. The comment's own words: 'source.access describes access/redistribution rights, not whether the file participates in Git.' Introduce an explicit storage-mode concept (e.g. a StorageMode enum: MainRepo / PrivateSubmodule / LocalOnly) that a Restricted-access paper can be assigned independently of its rights -- Open papers are presumably always MainRepo, but Restricted papers may be either PrivateSubmodule (when a private literature submodule is configured) or LocalOnly (today's existing, still-default behaviour). Must not change the default: an unconfigured library keeps today's exact LocalOnly-for-Restricted behaviour. Where this lives (SourceRef field vs. derived from root config + access) is a design decision for whoever picks this up.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Implemented: StorageMode enum (MainRepo/PrivateSubmodule/Local, default Local) added to crates/kovan/src/entity.rs, SourceRef gained a storage field (serde default), EntityConfig::with_storage() builder, EntityError::UnsafeStorage + validate() rejecting MainRepo storage combined with non-committable Access (the one structural, root-independent invariant this layer can enforce -- whether a configured private submodule actually exists is root.rs's job, checked at read time by op-t1ex's degradation logic, not by entity.rs's pure validate()). 8 new tests. Verified: cargo check -p kovan --all-targets --all-features clean; cargo test -p kovan --lib --release: 365 passed (was 352), 0 failed.

title: Decouple Access (redistribution rights) from git storage mode

description: op-bsz ported the HOMOGENEOUS single-moderator slowing-down flux (genflx groupr.f90:5396-5620, nalph=1) and verified it reduces to the Bondarenko flux bit-identically. The heterogeneity/multi-moderator terms remain NotPorted in src/groupr/slowing_down.rs: k=2/k=3 moderator accumulation, beta (Dancoff), admixed sam, external-fraction gamma (groupr.f90:5468-5471,5496-5499,5513-5516,5536-5539). Any nonzero beta/sam/alpha2/alpha3/gamma returns NjoyError::NotPorted. Also: the finite-dilution scattering quadrature (f3/f4/g3/g4 log-slowing-down integrals) has no independent benchmark yet — needs an analytic constant-scatterer (1/E) infinite-medium solution or a golden NJOY genflx flux for finite-dilution validation.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
2026-09-10 (session_01AhE6XBx3nRd81aHLQrciQe): the "golden NJOY genflx flux for finite-dilution validation" this bead asked for now exists, and the HOMOGENEOUS branch is validated against it.

Oracle: NJOY2016 ac5adf5, the U-238 GROUPR deck (29 groups, 6 sigz, 293.6 K) with iwt=-3 and card 8a `fehi=1e4 sigpot=11.29 nflmax=300000` (golden reference-data/gendf/u238-ENDF8.0-293.6K-29g-iwt-3-fehi1e4-6sigz.gendf + deck). NJOY's own listing fixes the grid: 926 tail points (1e-5 -> 0.0997 eV), 99,934 solved points (0.1 eV -> 1e4), 55,488 NR points to 3e7 eV. Test: tests/groupr_u238_gendf_golden.rs tier 4 (`njoy_flux_calculator_slowing_down`, env OUTRAM_PARK_NJOY_U238_PENDF).

Three port defects in slowing_down::genflx_slowing_down, each read out of groupr.f90 first and then confirmed by the measurement (commit "GROUPR flux calculator validated ..."):
 1. tail below felo: NJOY tabulates factor*wtf on getwtf's 1 % ladder (:5563-5577) - the port had ONE point at ebot=1e-5 eV, i.e. a lin-lin 1/E across four decades (group-1 flux would be off by ~x500). Fixed: walk min(weight.next_break, 1.01*e) from ebot while e < felo (926 points, matches).
 2. NR extension above fehi: NJOY steps by min(getwtf's 1.01*e, gety1's next point) (:5626-5631); the port marched the sigt grid only. Fixed (55,489 points vs NJOY's 55,488 - the one extra is the 3e7 eV top point, outside every group).
 3. NR in-scatter source below fehi (:5460): `f1=(1-alpha*fehi/e)*wtf/(1-alpha)` uses the loop's LAST wtf = the weight at fehi, not wtf(e). With wtf(e) the 5-10 keV group flux was 7.4e-4 off at sigz=1 b (everything else <= 8e-6); with wtf(fehi) it is 3.9e-7. Ported as-is (upstream is the spec; comment in the code says so).
 The solved region's grid (gety1's enext only, no 1 % steps, :5434-5447) was already right.

MEASURED after the fixes, 29 groups x 6 sigz, MT 1/2/18/102: sigma_g within 2.87e-6 (MT=102, group 9, sigz=1e3) / 1.95e-6 (MT=18); group flux within 3.89e-7 (MT=1, group 21, sigz=1 b) - NJOY's 7-significant-figure storage floor. groupr:: lib tests 77/77.

STILL OPEN on this bead (unchanged): the heterogeneity / multi-moderator terms (beta, sam, alpha2, alpha3, gamma; groupr.f90:5468-5471, 5496-5499, 5513-5516, 5536-5539) return NotPorted. The same oracle deck with non-zero card-8a `alpha2 sam beta alpha3 gamma` would give the golden for that half; the tier-4 test's compare()/flux_override plumbing is ready for it.

description: Found 2026-08-11 by correlation audit during op-4542. crates/tuas_boussinesq_solver/src/lib/heat_transfer_correlations/nusselt_number_correlations/pipe_correlations.rs:246-248 panics on Re > 10000, and the doc at ~L183-187 states 4000 < Re_D < 10000. Sieder & Tate (1936) is a turbulent correlation valid for Re > 1e4 -- 10000 is the LOWER bound, not the upper. Combined with the Re < 4000 panic below it, the function accepts only 4000-10000, a window almost entirely outside the correlation's validity, and refuses every Reynolds number where it is actually valid. The algebra itself (0.027 Re^0.8 Pr^(1/3) (mu_b/mu_w)^0.14) is correct.
title: tuas: Sieder-Tate Reynolds validity bounds inverted (accepts only 4000-10000, rejects Re > 1e4 where it is valid)
